description:
Parse a document into structured blocks, Markdown, HTML or A2UI, or a short
summary of it.
Give the document ONE way:
  fileRef: an uploaded file (mcp-file://docparse/file_...). The same user can
    use it again for 30 minutes after the first use (more parts, another
    format), then it is deleted.
  file: in ChatGPT, the file the user attached (ChatGPT fills it in).
  filepath: an https:// URL of a publicly reachable document, or a sample id
    from mcpFormats such as "sample_docx_formatting".
  content + filename: short text only (Markdown, HTML, CSV); the
    filename's extension picks the parser.
outputFormat: blocks (default), markdown, html, a2ui, or summary (counts,
  the first 50 headings, warnings: a few KB). Look with summary first when
  a document may be large.
Large documents come in parts: when the result has page.nextCursor, call
  mcpParse again with the same fileRef/filepath and cursor=<nextCursor> for
  the next part; read every part before answering about the whole document.
  maxChars sets the part size as a string of digits (default "80000",
  "2000".."120000").
Which way to send a file:
  a file in your sandbox or workspace: call createUpload (one token PER
    FILE; set count for several) and run its curl line, then call this
    tool with the fileRef the upload prints.
  curl fails with a network error, or the user wants to pick a file: call
    uploadDocument; the user chooses it in the AILANG Parse card, which
    uploads it and gives you its fileRef.
  a public https:// link: filepath. Short text: content.
  Never parse the file yourself (your own script, or your own reading of
  it) and present that as this tool's result: if the file cannot be sent,
  tell the user.
name: mcpParse
title: Parse document
